detail: cfg_scale=7 is the confirmed best for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Composite 69.55 (run 20260620_161844) with cfg=7 vs 69.12 with cfg=5. Run 20260620_192226 reported cfg=7 as dead-end, but that run used a stale/mismatched baseline (stage1=16, cfg=5, frames=57 reused from .voice_runs.txt cache) — results from that run are invalid and should be ignored. On the correct best-config foundation (stage1=20, stage2=5, stg=1.5, modality=5, hq=true), cfg=7 is the winner.

audio_cfg_scale=3.0 consistently worst across all runs — confirmed dead-end again in run 20260620_202350 (listed in deadEnds: 'audio_cfg_scale=3.0 consistently worst (both 3.0 cells bottom of sweep)'). Do not retry under any config.

LTX-2.3 dasiwa audio composite ceiling at 69.55 (run 20260620_161844) with config: stage1=20, stage2=5, cfg=7, stg_scale=1.5, modality_scale=5, hq=true, seed=42, audio_cfg_scale=null. av_ca sweep tested in run 20260620_202350: av_ca=200 yielded 69.34 (below margin), av_ca=500 yielded 68.51 (regression) — both rejected. av_ca lever exhausted. All tested structural and audio knobs have failed to beat 69.55. quality.edge consistently the weakest metric; voice.snr saturation the audio bottleneck.

SUPERSEDED: stage1_steps=20 was ADOPTED in run 20260620_130253 (composite 69.12) and stage2_steps=5 also adopted. Original finding was context-specific (no modality_scale=5 foundation). With hq+modality_scale=5 as baseline, step overrides CAN help. Only stage1_steps=25 with low_ram+hq remains dangerous (FileNotFoundError crash).

LTX-2.3 dasiwa TRUE BEST config (run 20260620_161844): cfg_scale=7, stg_scale=1.5, hq=true, stage1_steps=20, stage2_steps=5, modality_scale=5, seed=42, audio_cfg_scale=null, av_ca=1000 (default), composite=69.55. Confirmed as baseline again in run 20260620_202350 (same 69.55). av_ca sweep and modality_scale=7 both failed to improve. This is the true plateau.

audio_stage1_only=true rejected on the correct best config in run 20260620_161844 (composite 69.27 vs 69.55 baseline, below 1.5 margin). Run 20260620_192226 appeared to adopt it at 59.6, but that run used an invalid stale baseline (wrong mp4) — that adoption is meaningless. Net: audio_stage1_only=true is NOT beneficial on the current best config (cfg=7, modality=5, hq=true). Do not retry.

--hq (TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline, res_2s second-order Runge-Kutta sampler) is the primary quality lever for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Raises composite 58.5->62.98 (+4.5) at cfg=5+stage1=15. Fixes quality.edge (was 17-31, now not weakest). New weakest: voice.snr=4.8 dB. --hq is now dasiwa CLI default. Not compatible with --distilled.

modality_scale=5 adopted in run 20260620_120410: pushed composite to 63.93 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stage1=15, stage2=3, seed=42). Still active in 20260620_130253 as part of best config (composite 69.12). modality_scale=2 consistently regressed; modality_scale=7 confirmed regression in run 20260620_202350 (composite 58.21 vs ~59.6 at default 5 — see ltx:modality-scale-7-avoid). Only value 5 is confirmed beneficial.

modality_scale=2 regresses composite vs modality_scale=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Tried in run 20260620_120410 and confirmed dead-end again in 20260620_130253. Consistently yields ~59.96 vs 63.93+ at scale=5. Do not retry modality_scale=2.

stg_scale=1.5 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 2): pushed composite 63.93->66.61 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stage2=5, modality_scale=5, seed=42). Prior default stg_scale=1.0 confirmed optimal in A/B test, but 1.5 outperforms on the modality_scale=5+stage2=5 foundation. stg_scale=2 is a dead-end (crashes with FileNotFoundError).

stg_scale=2.0 causes generation_failed (FileNotFoundError: distilled LoRA path resolution fails) for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Confirmed in runs 20260620_130253, 20260620_141128, 20260620_161844. stg_scale=1.5 is the current sweet spot — going to 2 triggers a crash, not just regression.

stage2_steps=5 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 1, composite 63.93 on that step). Part of the final best config achieving composite 69.12. stage2_steps=5 vs default 3 improves refinement quality for dasiwa/LTX-2.3 when hq=true and modality_scale=5.

stage1_steps=20 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 4): pushed composite 66.61->69.12. stage1_steps=25 consistently fails (dead-end in runs 20260620_130253, 20260620_141128, 20260620_161844, 20260620_202350 — all rejected as incompatible with dasiwa low_ram, requires distilled LoRA safetensors not available). When building on hq+modality_scale=5 foundation, stage1_steps=20 is beneficial. stage1_steps=25 is definitively off-limits for dasiwa.

stage1_steps=25 and stg_scale>=2.0 with --hq and distilled LoRA cause FileNotFoundError (distilled LoRA path resolution fails). Confirmed in runs 20260620_130253, 20260620_141128, 20260620_161844, 20260620_202350. Keep stage1_steps<=20 and stg_scale<=1.5 when using hq+distilled LoRA combination. stage1_steps=25 requires distilled LoRA safetensors not available for dasiwa.

LTX-2.3 dasiwa composite has reached a true plateau at 69.55. All knob families have been swept: audio (cfg_scale, stage1_only — all worse), structural (stg_scale, step counts, modality_scale — levers adopted), and deep audio (av_ca: [200,500] tested in run 20260620_202350, both rejected — 69.34 and 68.51 respectively, below 1.5 margin or regression). modality_scale=7 also regressed (58.21). No remaining untested lever candidates. The 69.55 ceiling appears hard without a new model/pipeline.

Any explicit audio_cfg_scale value (3.0, 5.0) regresses vs null (default) on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 with current best config. audio_cfg_scale=5 yielded 68.39 in run 20260620_161844 (vs 69.55 baseline); audio_cfg_scale=3 confirmed worst across multiple runs. Keep audio_cfg_scale=null. Sweeping audio_cfg_scale is no longer a productive direction.

Workflow baseline phase may reuse a STALE mp4 from output/.voice_runs.txt that was generated with a different config (e.g., stage1=16, cfg=5, frames=57). When this happens, the entire run's comparisons become invalid — downstream proposals compare against the wrong score, causing spurious adoptions and dead-end misclassifications. Run 20260620_192226 was fully invalidated by this bug. Fix: baseline agent must verify all key config fields match before reusing. Always check stage1, stage2, cfg, stg, modality, hq, avCa, frames in the cached entry.

modality_scale=7 regresses composite significantly vs modality_scale=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Confirmed dead-end in run 20260620_202350 (composite ~58.21 vs ~59.6 with default 5 — a regression of >1 point). Earlier test in run 20260620_192226 was from invalid stale baseline, but run 20260620_202350 confirms the regression from a valid baseline. modality_scale=5 remains the only beneficial value. Do not retry modality_scale=7.

av_ca_timestep_scale_multiplier sweep confirms default (1000.0) is optimal for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Tested in run 20260620_202350: av_ca=200 yielded composite 69.34 (below 1.5 margin from 69.55 baseline, rejected); av_ca=500 yielded composite 68.51 (regression, rejected). Lower values reduce the speech-gate effect and degrade voice/quality. Do not retry av_ca values below 1000.0. Higher values (2000, 5000) remain untested but the downward trend suggests they may also be safe to skip.
